session7Outcome.item: All eight genuine Council of Knives principals survived.
Active MIRRORGLASS security and principal copies were destroyed.
Genuine Simon Blumfeld, Charlton Branson and Margaret Fuhler were recovered alive from suspended animation beneath Concilium.
PALE contacted Tom Hendry and Q directly and stated: "I have what I need. I'll perhaps see you at Daybreak."
Three biological seed consignments were traced through DAYBREAK GATE.
Bureau Noir confirmed Daybreak Gate had resumed communications and was transmitting.
